items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: George Geno I remember told me about him.

ctx.x: I forgot about him too. Yeah. Old man Glennie. He lived over in your neighborhood there too. Yeah. And I'll tell you another boy used to play some nice bass, Cleo. You hear the author of Cleo? I've heard of him but never knew him. Well he got killed after hearing the go. He was waking on the ship.
George Geno I remember told me about him.
Yeah, yeah. So he was a pretty nice little bass player.
